_source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 (Allen et al., 1998), checked against https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm on 2026-11-04. Kc: Table 12 (single crop coefficients); Kc ini is the crop group's value where the crop row leaves it blank. Stage lengths in days (initial, development, mid-season, late): Table 11, one planting per crop (Mediterranean rows where they exist); local seasons differ.

sugar_beet.stages_note: May sowing, Mediterranean; Kc end up to 1.0 when irrigated or rained on in the last month (Table 12 note 5)

spinach.stages_note: April planting, Mediterranean (Sep/Oct planting: mid-season 25 days)

cabbage.stages_note: September planting, California desert (the only cabbage row)

tomato.stages_note: April-May planting, Mediterranean; Kc end 0.70-0.90 in Table 12; staked plants 1.5-2 m tall: Kc mid 1.20 (note 2)

pepper.stages_note: sweet pepper, April-June planting, Europe and Mediterranean (initial stage 25-30 days)

wheat.stages_note: Barley/Oats/Wheat row, March-April planting, 35-45 degrees latitude (Table 11 has no separate spring wheat row); Kc end 0.25-0.4, the higher value for hand-harvested crops (Table 12 note 10)
